items.title: Regulators unveil plans to simplify Senior Manager and Certification Regime
items.summary: The number of financial services roles required to face enhanced checks from regulators will fall significantly under proposals that will support growth.
items.why: Major regulatory proposal significantly scaling back certification requirements for financial roles.

items.title: Federal Reserve Board requests public comment on two proposals related to establishing a regulatory framework for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act
items.summary: Federal Reserve Board requests public comment on two proposals related to establishing a regulatory framework for Board-supervised payment stablecoin issuers under the GENIUS Act
items.why: New rule proposals establishing a regulatory framework for Fed-supervised payment stablecoin issuers.

items.title: UK sets out proposal to open up access to iPhone contactless payments
items.summary: The UK's competition watchdog is consulting on proposals to unlock contactless technology on iPhones, making it easier for Apple Pay rivals to flourish by lowering fees and removing technical ​barriers.
items.why: UK regulator proposes formal competition rules opening Apple contactless payments to rivals.

items.title: NAB cuts 2,500 jobs citing technological change
items.summary: National Australia Bank (NAB) is to axe 2,500 employees in its latest restructuring, equivalent to 6% of the workforce
items.why: Major bank restructuring cutting 2,500 jobs citing technological change.

items.title: NatWest orders 30,000 staff to spend more time in the office
items.summary: UK banking giant NatWest has told tens of thousands of employees to spend more time in the office in a move described as a kick in the teeth by union Unite.
items.why: Major UK bank imposes broad return-to-office mandate affecting 30,000 employees.

items.title: Programmable banking platform Hyperlayer raises £19.5m
items.summary: Hyperlayer, the London-based fintech founded by former Morgan Stanley executives to help banks modernise without replacing their core systems, has raised £19.5 million at a £195 million valuation.
items.why: Significant funding round for a prominent enterprise fintech serving traditional banks.

items.title: Starling build agentic fincrime investigator that takes 17 seconds
items.summary: Starling has deployed an agentic financial crime investigator that the UK digital bank says can carry out an end-to-end investigation within 17 seconds.
items.why: Major deployment of autonomous AI agents for financial crime investigations in banking.

items.title: Checkout.com expands into in-person payments
items.summary: Checkout.com, a leading global payments company, today announced its expansion into in-person payments, in response to significant demand from enterprise merchants seeking the performance and resilience of its online acquiring platform in stores.
items.why: Major online payment player expanding into physical point-of-sale infrastructure.

items.title: Evervault launches Browser Tokens, enabling secure agentic payments
items.summary: Evervault today announced the launch of Browser Tokens at Money20/20, giving developers building agentic commerce products a secure way for AI agents and browser automations to make purchases, log in to accounts and complete sensitive online workflows without exposing payment cards, passwords or personal data to the agent or browser provider.
items.why: New product launch enabling AI agent autonomous payment workflows.

items.title: Standard Chartered to acquire Zodia Custody
items.summary: UK bank and global custodian Standard Chartered is set to acquire digital assets service provider Zodia Custody.
items.why: Major acquisition of a digital asset custodian by a global custodian bank.

items.title: India's largest bank hit by cyberattack
items.summary: State Bank of India (SBI), the country's largest lending institution by assets, has launched an internal investigation after an alleged cyberattack exposed user's personal information.
items.why: Major cyberattack exposing customer data at India's largest bank.

items.title: Singapore's Sea plans IPO for fintech arm Monee
items.summary: Singapore-based conglomerate is planng to float its fintech arm, Monee, on the Singapore Stock Exchange (SGX)
items.why: Sea's planned IPO for its fintech arm is a major market listing move.

items.title: Coinbase fined €3.25m by Irish central bank
items.summary: Crypto exchange Coinbase Ireland has been penalised by the Central Bank of Ireland (CBI) for a series of operational and governance failings over a five-year period.
items.why: Regulatory enforcement action against a major crypto firm by a central bank.

items.title: LSEG to acquire data provider Octus for $3.5bn
items.summary: The London Stock Exchange (LSEG) has agreed to acquire credit data provider Octus in a cash deal worth $3.535bn.
items.why: Major multibillion-dollar acquisition reshaping financial market data infrastructure.

items.title: Fireblocks pours cold water on reports of $2.5bn acquisition talks with Visa
items.summary: Digital asset and stablecoin infrastructure provider Fireblocks says that reports that it is in talks to be acquired by Visa for $2.5 billion are news to us .
items.why: Denial of major $2.5bn fintech acquisition talks.

items.title: Banks move to limit agents' access to customer accounts
items.summary: The CEOs of Canada's RBC and BMO are the latest bank chiefs to warn customers about the dangers of linking their accounts to AI agents.
items.why: Major Canadian banks are moving to restrict AI agents from accessing customer accounts over security concerns.

items.title: UK and EU financial regulators seek answers from Google over cloud outage
items.summary: The European Banking Authority and the UK's Financial Conduct Authority have been in contact with Google over the major cloud outage earlier this week that knocked out several bank websites.
items.why: Joint regulatory inquiry by UK and EU authorities into Google over a major cloud outage.

items.title: SoFi launches tokenised deposits
items.summary: SoFi Technologies, Inc. (NASDAQ: SOFI), the everything app for digital financial services, today announced the launch of SoFi Earn (SOFIE), the first and only national bank-issued tokenized deposit for consumers.
items.why: First national bank-issued tokenised deposit for consumers launched by SoFi.

items.title: HSBC launches first stablecoin
items.summary: Global bank HSBC has launched RedCoin, its first stablecoin, for public use.
items.why: Major global bank launches its first public stablecoin, marking significant digital asset expansion.

items.title: Thailand and Malaysia back Singapore's BLOOM cross-border digital money initiative
items.summary: The central banks Thailand and Malaysia are backing a Monetary Authority of Singapore-led public-private sector initiative to advance cross-border settlement in digital money.
items.why: Central bank support for cross-border digital money initiative marks significant monetary tech policy expansion.

items.title: Riksbank reignites e-krona debate
items.summary: With cash usage down, a digital euro on the horizon and stablecoins gathering momentum, Sweden's central bank has reignited a debate on whether the country should roll out its own e-krona.
items.why: Central bank reopens sovereign digital currency debate amid cash decline and digital euro developments.

items.title: Revolut launches personal loans in the UK
items.summary: Revolut is stepping up its challenge to the UK's high street banks with the introduction of a personal loan product.
items.why: Revolut expands into UK consumer lending with the launch of personal loans.

items.title: Japan tells banks to review cyber policies following wave of attacks
items.summary: Japan is drafting an emergency cybersecurity policy package and telling banks to review their own policies in response to a wave of hacks.
items.why: Japan drafting emergency cybersecurity regulatory package instructing banks to review policies following attacks.

items.title: NAB to slash up to 2,500 jobs in massive restructure
items.summary: National Australia Bank says it will cut about 6 per cent of its workforce by mid-2027, as it overhauls its operating model.
items.why: Major Australian bank announces unexpected mass redundancies and operational restructuring.

items.title: RBA deputy warns inflation outlook 'materially worse' as next decision looms
items.summary: As markets put the chance of a rate hike in November at 42 per cent, Reserve Bank deputy governor Andrew Hauser warns of a "central banker's nightmare".
items.why: Hawkish central bank warning signaling worsening inflation and potential rate hike.

items.title: Tech giant shares plunge 40pc after delays to Melbourne data centre
items.summary: Community opposition to one of Victoria's largest data centres has seen the value of shares in NextDC plummet.
items.why: Unexpected massive market sell-off with 40% share price collapse for major ASX tech firm.

items.title: NAB staff speak out after mass job cuts revealed
items.summary: NAB workers say the writing was on the wall regarding mass redundancies as the major bank pushes towards an offshore workforce and the uptake of AI.
items.why: Major bank mass job cuts revealed as part of AI and offshoring shift.

items.title: Exclusive: Revolut customers hit by fresh security breach
items.why: Exclusive report of a fresh security breach affecting customers at major fintech Revolut.

items.title: Australia's second largest veggie company admits 'cartel conduct'
items.summary: Perfection Fresh Australia has admitted fixing the price of broccoli, cauliflower and lettuce sold to Aldi stores in New South Wales.
items.why: Major producer admits illegal price-fixing cartel conduct in supermarket supply chain.

items.title: L2 Capital Picks Newton to Tokenize $500m Pre-IPO AI Shares
items.summary: The Hong Kong investment firm will use Newton Labs' compliance protocol to put late-stage private technology holdings onchain for eligible investors. The post L2 Capital Picks Newton to Tokenize $500m Pre-IPO AI Shares appeared first on The Fintech Times .
items.why: Major fintech deal tokenizing $500m of late-stage private AI equity.
